Appraiser remarks
The rear bumper cover is cracked across its lower center, and the left taillight
assembly is broken with the housing pushed inward. Scuffing and paint transfer run
along the left quarter panel, which lines up with the reported low-speed contact in the
parking lot. Nothing I inspected suggests older damage: the edges are fresh, and no
prior repair work is visible. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, the
taillight assembly and the left quarter panel trim, followed by refinishing. The labor
hours requested fit the scope of this damage, and the invoices submitted show a single
set of charges with no duplicated line items.
